helpPage.title: ASSISTANCE PROTOCOL — KIWI-OPS HELP CENTER —
helpPage.description: Access documentation, FAQs, and support channels for all operational requests.
helpPage.faqIntro: Find answers to the most common questions from our agents.
helpPage.faq1Q: How can I change my secret code?
helpPage.faq1A: Go to 'Headquarters Settings' (gear icon in the sidebar), then navigate to 'Security Protocols'. You can initiate the change there.
helpPage.faq2Q: Where can I find archived mission reports?
helpPage.faq2A: Reports are accessible via the 'Classified Files' section (folder icon in the sidebar). Use filters to refine by category or date.
helpPage.faq3A: Yes, intelligence contributions are encouraged. Submission protocol is detailed in the 'Intelligence Operations' section (coming soon).
helpPage.contactIntro: If you didn't find an answer to your request, our team is ready to assist you.
helpPage.contactInstruction: For fast assistance, please contact us via the secure channels below:
helpPage.contactConfidentiality: "All communications are handled with the utmost discretion and confidentiality."
